Armour of Contempt.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armour of Contempt.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armour of Contempt.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Armour of Contempt.lore: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

Duty and Honour.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD**, **STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD** or **VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD** unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Duty and Honour.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Duty and Honour.lore: Adeptus Astartes veterans claim critical objectives in daring strikes, annihilating resistance in their Chapter’s name before sweeping onto their next target.

Heroes of the Chapter.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Heroes of the Chapter.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD**, **STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD** or **VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Heroes of the Chapter.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
Heroes of the Chapter.lore: When the fighting is at its fiercest, the veteran warriors of the Chapter truly show their quality.

Legendary Fortitude.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
Legendary Fortitude.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD**, **STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD** or **VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD** unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Legendary Fortitude.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Legendary Fortitude.lore: Many are the legendary tales of the 1st Company holding their ground against the odds, weathering assaults that would have swept away lesser warriors.

Orbital Teleportarium.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Orbital Teleportarium.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR** unit from your army.
Orbital Teleportarium.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability.
Orbital Teleportarium.lore: Teleportarium chambers within orbiting strike cruisers are able to perform site-to-strike teleportations for Terminator-armoured battle-brothers in extremis.

Battle Drill Recall.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Battle Drill Recall.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability. If your unit Remained Stationary this turn, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Battle Drill Recall.lore: Space Marines train for countless hours to master their weapons and in the heat of battle can trigger mnemonic patterning to recall their ritual drills and ensure the foe’s destruction.

Hail of Vengeance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Hail of Vengeance.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hail of Vengeance.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
Hail of Vengeance.lore: Space Marines’ incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.

No Threat Too Great.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
No Threat Too Great.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
No Threat Too Great.lore: To combat an entrenched force of Space Marines, foes resort to armoured vehicles or packs of murderous monstrosities. Even the greatest of behemoths has a chink in its armour and the Adeptus Astartes are well versed in exploiting such weaknesses.

Not One Backwards Step.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army within range of an objective marker.
Not One Backwards Step.effect: Until the end of the turn, double the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit, but it must Remain Stationary this turn.
Not One Backwards Step.lore: Siege warfare is incomparably brutal. Space Marines battle with the fiercest determination to achieve victory, and will fight unto death to hold every defensive line or to secure gains they have wrested from the enemy.

Advanced Deployment.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Advanced Deployment.effect: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your Transport after it has Advanced. Mercy Is Weakness.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability, and when making such an attack, if the attacking model is a **VEHICLE**, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Mercy Is Weakness.lore: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.

Power of the Machine Spirit.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Power of the Machine Spirit.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE** unit from your army that was reduced to Below Half-strength as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Power of the Machine Spirit.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
Power of the Machine Spirit.lore: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.

Unbowed Conviction.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
Unbowed Conviction.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
Unbowed Conviction.lore: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even injured, they will never abandon their oaths.

Vengeful Animus.when: Any phase, just after an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE** model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
Vengeful Animus.target: That **ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE** model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Vengeful Animus.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
Vengeful Animus.lore: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.

Blind Screen.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blind Screen.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly Adeptus Astartes Smoke Vehicle or Drop Pod unit within 9" of it.
Blind Screen.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your units have the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets one of your units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Onward for the Emperor.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was not set up on the battlefield this turn and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.

Shock Onslaught.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Shock Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile‑in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Suppression Strafing.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.
Suppression Strafing.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to and within 18" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle‑shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from that test and, if that test is failed, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Suppression Strafing.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Crusading Conquerors.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.
Crusading Conquerors.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

Fight to the End.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Fight to the End.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Fight to the End.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Furious Dedication.when: Your Charge phase or the Fight phase. 1CP

Furious Dedication.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Furious Dedication.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

Strike From the Shadows.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot.
Strike From the Shadows.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

A Deadly Prize.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** or **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
A Deadly Prize.effect: That objective marker is said to be Sabotaged, and remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Sabotaged and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
A Deadly Prize.lore: Warriors of a Vanguard Spearhead will rig critical objectives with explosives to deny them to the enemy.

Armour of Contempt.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armour of Contempt.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armour of Contempt.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Armour of Contempt.lore: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

Guerrilla Tactics.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Guerrilla Tactics.target: Up to two **PHOBOS** and/or **SCOUT SQUAD** units from your army, or one other **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army.
Guerrilla Tactics.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
Guerrilla Tactics.lore: At the opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.

Surgical Strikes.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Surgical Strikes.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[PRECISION]** ability.
